verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes 141GB of HBM3e at 4.8TB/s for the H200, enough to hold a quantized 70B model on a single GPU, and it cites first-party Llama2 70B inference running 1.9X faster than H100. Community reports of Llama 405B served at 142 tok/s on H200 SXM in production back up its practicality for large-LLM inference, and the 'same die, more memory' comment supports that the gain comes from memory. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a quantized 70B model on one H200, and support for 'local' use, since the SXM part ships only in 4- or 8-GPU HGX/certified server systems.
